state_machine.description: Fresh instance before first scan; declared outputs and internal state at initial values.
Valid sensor, no active overheat protection, no heat demand.
Valid sensor, heatDemand true, heater commanded until trip, demand clear, or fault.

transitions.when: heatLimitReached OR tripNow; continuous energized time >= 5s

state_machine.description: Overheat protection latched; heater off; cooldown timer runs from trip time.
Invalid sensor: TemperatureSensorInput < 0 or > 100. Heater off, heat timer reset, heatDemand frozen.

timer_plan.name: HeatContinuityTimer
timer_plan.IN: heatEnable = (state=HEATING OR (cooldownDonePred AND !sensorFault AND heatDemand)) AND !sensorFault AND !protectionForHeat AND heatDemand
timer_plan.trip: Q true at ET>=5s; set heatLimitReached/tripNow, protectionLatched=true, protectionStart=now, and force HeaterOutput=false in the same scan.
timer_plan.reset: IN=false; sensorFault; protectionLatched or protectionNext; heatDemand=false; leaving HEATING; after trip detection or initialization.

timer_plan.name: CooldownTimer
timer_plan.IN: protectionLatched OR tripNow; call after HeatContinuityTimer so a same-scan trip starts cooldown immediately.
timer_plan.trip: Q true at ET>=3s; cooldownDone=true. At cooldownDone clear protection in that scan unless a new trip exists; same-scan heat restart is allowed if sensor is valid and heatDemand remains.
timer_plan.reset: protectionLatched=false AND tripNow=false; initialization; after cooldownDone has cleared protection.

safety: Sensor fault, TemperatureSensorInput < 0 or > 100, or active overheat protection overrides heat demand and forces HeaterOutput=false.
Protection trip is evaluated before final output. Continuous energized time >=5s latches OverheatProtection and forces HeaterOutput=false in the trip scan.

During OverheatProtection, HeaterOutput remains false until cooldownDone, i.e. at least 3s from trip. At cooldownDone the protection must clear in that scan; heating may restart in the same scan only when sensor is valid and heatDemand remains.
Sensor fault resets the continuous-heating timer; it neither clears nor restarts an already active cooldown. During sensorFault, heatDemand is frozen.
operational: If TemperatureSensorInput < SetTemperature, set heatDemand=true; if > SetTemperature, set heatDemand=false; at equality retain prior heatDemand, initially false.
HeaterOutput is true only when sensor valid, no OverheatProtection, heatDemand true, heatLimit not reached, and the state permits heating.
CurrentTemperature mirrors TemperatureSensorInput and SetTempDisplay mirrors SetTemperature every scan, including during fault.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
actions: Capture comparison edges and previous observed OverheatProtection; compute dt_ms with the first scan treated as zero for timer initialization.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
actions: Apply safety priority first: sensorFault or active protection forces the internal heat command false and resets HeatContinuityTimer.
Update heatDemand: frozen during sensorFault; otherwise true when below setpoint, false when above setpoint, retained at equality.
Evaluate state transitions using sampled inputs, heatDemand, protectionLatched, and timer status; do not assign output ports in this stage.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
actions: Call HeatContinuityTimer unconditionally with PT=T#5S and IN derived from the stage-2 heat enable, using cooldownDonePred to permit same-scan restart after cooldown.
If HeatContinuityTimer.Q, set heatLimitReached/tripNow, protectionLatched=true, protectionStart=now.
Call CooldownTimer unconditionally with PT=T#3S and IN=(protectionLatched OR tripNow); derive cooldownDone and protectionNext, clearing protectionLatched when cooldownDone and no trip.
Timer reset is performed through IN conditions; no timer FB call is placed inside CASE/IF.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
actions: Assign CurrentTemperature := TemperatureSensorInput and SetTempDisplay := SetTemperature.
Assign OverheatProtection := protectionNext, i.e. protection active and not cooldownDone, OR tripNow.
Assign HeaterOutput := heatCommand AND NOT sensorFault AND NOT OverheatProtection AND NOT heatLimitReached.
